recommended_steps.detail: Under the no-Byzantine ruling, a coherent edit of a located row and its witness, and a forged repeated event id with a later timestamp, are proposed as threat-model exclusions, not fixed defects. Record whether you accept that.
recommended_steps.title: Record the status of the two known gaps

see_for_yourself.expected: Identical namespace step counts at 100 and 5000 entries, diagnose refusing an untouched corruption, and one upload spending identical whole-store work at 100 and 1000 prior objects with zero whole-journal reads; temporary data is removed.
see_for_yourself.title: Compare upload work at two store sizes

what_just_landed.detail: A namespace upload checks the journal's last line, its own line, its index rows and its own file. It reads no whole journal and rewrites no whole index, so its work no longer grows with the content store.
what_just_landed.title: Content uploads now cost what they touch

what_just_landed.detail: A crash replay, a duplicate append, a lost namespace record or a restored older journal that repeats an event id is refused by the order of the appended range. Content excision keeps its own whole-journal check.
what_just_landed.title: Honest repeats are still refused

what_just_landed.detail: The explicit v1 migration verifies each 0.3.0 upload receipt against the journal before converting it.
what_just_landed.title: 0.3.0 receipts migrate
